notes.title: SaiIn Rhythm Update - Rhythm Challenge LeaderBoard&Soundtrack Released
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584572/08752db4a835d05d19002fbbeb045fb56f36b19e.png
SaiIn Rhythm Update.

Rhythm Challenge LeaderBoard 

 View the leaderboard by Gallery->Challenge->LeaderBoard
 Challenge gallery can only be unlocked by clearing the story challenge.
 You can unlock challenge gallery immediately by cheat mode (hold down key C for 3 seconds)
 Rhythm challenge in the gallery is the same as the story


SaiIn Rhythm

 Added some rhythm challenges to the H scene to increase gameplay
 Results here will not count to the leaderboard
 You can skip these challenge with cheat mode (key S)


Game SoundTrack

 Added 3 BGM for H scene
 Including the new 3 BGM, Soundtrack now available for free.


Others
BUG Fix
display quality improve
Game price adjust

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1794320/_/

notes.title: Update - Cheat Mode & Gallery
notes.notes:
After Releasing a few days, we heard the voice.
Cheat mode and gallery are added here.

Press down "C" key for 3 seconds to trigger the cheat mode.

Unlock all Achievements.
Unlock all gallery content.
You can press the "S" key to skip the rhythm challenge.
